title: Employment Pathways for Singaporeans who are Unable to Transition into New Occupations with Accelerating AI Adoption
what_it_is: Employment Pathways for Singaporeans who are Unable to Transition into New Occupations with Accelerating AI Adoption

sections.label: Supporting workers through AI job changes
sections.summary: Government supports workers as AI transforms jobs, with surveys showing most firms redesign jobs rather than cut headcount, and develops pathways into trades and care work.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Manpower (Ms Jasmin Lau)
sentences.text: The Government is committed to supporting workers as AI and automation transform jobs and businesses.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Manpower (Ms Jasmin Lau)
sentences.text: So far, our surveys show that most firms that adopt AI are redesigning jobs or creating new roles rather than reducing headcount.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Manpower (Ms Jasmin Lau)
sentences.text: For workers who may need to move into different roles, we are developing practical employment pathways into jobs with strong demand and good longer-term prospects.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Manpower (Ms Jasmin Lau)
sentences.text: This includes opportunities in the essential and skilled trades, such as electrical work, or in the social and community care sector where demand is expected to remain strong even as technology adoption accelerates.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Manpower (Ms Jasmin Lau)
sentences.text: These pathways are supported through career transition programmes, such as the Career Conversion Programmes and the SkillsFuture Career Transition Programme.

sections.label: Career Conversion Programme and Progressive Wage Model
sections.summary: Nearly nine in 10 Career Conversion Programme participants aged 51 and above stay employed 24 months on, while the Progressive Wage Model gives lower-wage workers career pathways.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Manpower (Ms Jasmin Lau)
sentences.text: Over the past five years, close to nine in 10 Career Conversion Programme participants aged 51 and above remain employed 24 months after embarking on the programme.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Manpower (Ms Jasmin Lau)
sentences.text: For lower-wage workers, the Progressive Wage Model provides clear career pathways with wage growth, supported by industry-relevant training requirements.

sections.label: Open Door Programme for disabled employment
sections.summary: The Open Door Programme supports employers with job redesign, workplace adaptations and inclusive hiring, and gives persons with disabilities stronger employment support.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Manpower (Ms Jasmin Lau)
sentences.text: Programmes, such as the Open Door Programme, support employers with job redesign, workplace adaptations and inclusive hiring practices, while providing persons with disabilities stronger employment support.
